fato_historico: 394: On the first day of the battle of Frigidus, the Western Roman troops of Arbogast manage to defend their positions against the Eastern Roman troops of emperor Theodosius I.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to hold your ground with grace, much like ancient defenders once stood firm on mountain paths. Today, you may find your inner strength tested by shifting tides, yet your spirit remains resilient. It is a good time to protect your boundaries while maintaining an optimistic outlook on the challenges that come your way.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in standing tall while keeping your heart open to change.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of hope and the promise of future luck.
conselho: Stand firm in your convictions while remaining gentle with those around you.
